propositions: scc LOC analyzer invokes scc via subprocess with --format json and parses the resulting JSON to produce AnalyzerResult.loc payload keyed by repo-relative POSIX file paths
when scc is unavailable (missing binary, non-zero exit, empty/unparseable stdout), analyze() returns Unavailable with reason and accruing_since, logging a warning, without fabricating zeros
the analyzer flattens scc's two-level JSON structure (language groups → per-file entries) extracting Code and Location fields and computing max_loc
scc_loc.py is self-contained in analyzers/ package, accepts injected run callable for testability, and does not import from grounding layer to avoid cross-layer coupling
successful empty output (no files) returns AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0, distinguishing success from unavailability
